mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP2D6, increasing haloperidol metabolism inhibition and elevating haloperidol levels; additive CNS depression and increased risk of extrapyramidal side effects and QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol toxicity including extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, and cardiac effects; consider haloperidol dose reduction or alternative antipsychotic; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
